description: Creates a new folder (deck) for the user. `lang` = language the words will be in; `native_lang` = language of the translations (omit to use the user's native language). Returns the new folder id; pass it to capture_word as `folder_id`. The user can undo it in MindDory settings.

lang.description: ISO code of the words, e.g. "es".

native_lang.description: Optional ISO code of the translations, e.g. "en".

name: create_folder
title: Create folder
